topic: LiDAR setup and physical installation testing
summary_markdown:
The discussion covered technical aspects of using LiDAR data, including methods like `frame_grabber` or OpenCV for 2D processing. A major focus was placed on the physical installation and testing of an Ouster LiDAR unit. It was determined that a PoE adapter (specifically mentioned as needing to be purchased) is required to test the Ouster LiDAR in situ.

Regarding the physical setup, multiple attempts were made to adjust the mounting height and aperture size for optimal scanning coverage. The consensus reached was that the hole/aperture should ideally match the dimensions of the upper part of the LiDAR unit (where the laser is located), as the receiver is at the bottom. Testing concluded with a suggestion to acquire an S2 model, which is noted to be smaller and would allow for a smaller aperture.
decisions: PoE adapter purchase is required to test the Ouster LiDAR.
The physical mounting hole size should match the upper dimensions of the LiDAR unit.
action_items: Acquire an S2 model for further testing and smaller aperture design.
